Reviewed the entire pinned landed diff against main 447a116ad003a5cd41c71330608a277592599f3f, landed tree e79b3795f0975056935fef37bdb5300ac2f6fb38, attesting original head 64a68c24a6180c827bf42553c6486de04b6dd37f. Request changes for unmet health and per-pass logging acceptance criteria. Four actionable findings, including the capped refusal count follow-up. No finding depends on the documentation changes added by the protected base; the three-commit stale-base condition was considered.

Full acceptance sweep, BUG-2674:
AC1: Dispatch up to max_concurrent reviews for open heads lacking conclusive verdicts within one interval: unverified end to end. Source evidence: run_with_program iterates discovery in one pass; select_with_coverage applies the capacity limit under the admission lock. No live timing observation was available.
AC2: A single PR refusal, especially a closed PR, never aborts processing the others: verified by watch_changes source and assertions in the added bug2674_refused_change_never_blocks_the_next_and_degrades_status fixture. Tagged whole-state/authority failures correctly remain fatal.
AC3: service.log records each pass with timestamp and dispatch count: unverified; controller_pass_report suppresses quiet pass lines for 300 seconds (finding 3).
AC4: Running but idle N minutes with eligible work is degraded: unverified; pass_degradation has neither eligible-work nor last-dispatch evidence and treats every recent error-free pass as healthy (finding 1). Absent pass evidence is also indefinitely healthy (finding 2).
Authoritative brief item 1: Discovery is open/non-draft only; closed/merged entries are pruned while preserving history and necessary live-attempt ownership: verified by parse_change, Store::prune and existing bug2640 closed-change fixtures. This behavior predates this PR.
Authoritative brief item 2: Record per-PR refusals/setup failures and continue: verified by watch_changes/record_skip source and the added continuation fixture, apart from transient busy admission being excluded from the report as described in finding 1. This continuation behavior predates this PR.
Authoritative brief item 3: Degrade last-pass per-PR errors and name them: verified by controller_pass_report, pass_degradation, pass_status and the added fixture for available reports; absence/stall coverage remains incomplete (finding 2).
Required regression: refused first change followed by eligible open change is admitted in the same pass and status names the error: verified by assertions in the added fixture; execution evidence is the implementer's reported 61 passing focused tests, not a reviewer execution.
Validation requested in brief: targeted review_watch tests and check-store-writers.py: verified by reported lane evidence in PR/spec comment. check-ci-fast: verified by successful exact-head CI fast gates, fast compile and Build (ubuntu-latest), run 44475205530. Full test shard was skipped under FAST policy. No local tests, Cargo or builds run by reviewer.
Type protocol BUG-2674 (bug protocol), touches at least one test file: met; advisor_loop_service.rs contains three new unit tests.

Navigation limitation: supplied absolute host codegraph client was absent; aida doctor check codegraph also reported a stale index. Source searches were used instead. No independent external evidence is needed to judge the source defects. Findings are structured JSON strings for the canonical recorder; all four are retained.
kind.recovery_hint: address the review findings, move BUG-2674 back to In Progress, and clear the PR hold only after approval
